**sdd/issue-253-b1/tasks**

**What**: Wrote openspec/changes/issue-253-b1/tasks.md — 9-phase TDD checklist for B1 (wire the gates onto the sdd-layout.mjs contract). Phases: 0 baseline, 1 golden fixture capture (F1, measured N not hardcoded), 2 wire six sites (REQ-B1-1, check-refs gets 4-artifact enforcement per #595 pin 1 with never-cryptic message), 3 BASELINE_EXEMPT_DIRS→LEGACY_GRANDFATHERED swap + tripwire consolidation, 4 drift-guard A3 (traps written before assertion), 5 new-change.mjs slug=ERROR (#595 pin 2), 6 synthetic edge fixtures, 7 gate baseline (npm test/repo:check/nav/change:verify), 8 co-promotion branch (Deliverable B, separate branch off feature/v2.0.0, pushed-not-opened).
**Why**: sdd-tasks phase for issue-253-b1, decomposing spec.md (REQ-B1-1..6) + design.md (per-site wiring table, golden harness, A3 precision map, slug mandate, co-promo prep) + #595 owner ruling into ordered, spec-linked tasks.
**Where**: /home/gandalf/IA/brain/openspec/changes/issue-253-b1/tasks.md
**Learned**: Review Workload Forecast verdict = single PR into feature/v2.0.0, ~43 counted lines, no size:exception, no chain — the co-promotion branch is a separate git artifact (Phase 8) not counted against this PR's budget. Open items from design §7 all resolved or explicitly deferred to owner call at apply time (tripwire consolidation defaults to "include now" pending override).
